svg.title: D6 Carried versus read
svg.desc: Past window at x; two fitted targets: carried (the same stream's future) and read (the next layer's update at x) [P5, P6]. The ladder is an idealized Bayes-risk schematic: fitted held-out risks need not fall or reach zero; not architectural use.

text.tspan: two targets for the same past [P5]
risk ℛ of predicting the read target Δh
plotted: idealized Bayes risks; measured: held-out risks
Bayes risks are nested, so they never increase [thm];
fitted held-out risks need not decrease or reach zero,
and are reported as a sequence, not an inequality.
They measure predictive information at this window
and scale, not the layer's architectural use of context.
Past window at x; two fitted targets: carried (the same stream's future) and read (the next layer's update at x) [P5, P6].
The ladder is an idealized Bayes-risk schematic: fitted held-out risks need not fall or reach zero; not architectural use.
